content: The Official 24h league contains four active strategies split across two families and two pair universes. Cosmo & Wanda variants hold nominal equity leadership but are effectively stalled: Top 50 is Restarted with no closed trades since June 9 and ~-$35 in open drag, while the incumbent Top 20 champion has not traded since June 8 and carries ~-$56 in unchecked unrealized losses. In contrast, Timmy variants reveal a stark structural split: Top 50 is the sole net-positive prospect with clean v3 telemetry, a 35% win rate, and positive realized hourly alpha, whereas Top 20 is underwater with negative realized alpha despite an identical win-rate phenotype. The league is currently monitoring whether broader pair coverage sustains opportunity for low-win-rate profiles, whether Cosmo & Wanda's champion exit logic can function under live conditions, and whether the Restarted Top-50 tape represents recovery or persistent execution failure.
